summary: VICI Properties Inc. and subsidiary VICI Properties L.P. filed an 8-K on August 5, 2026, disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement for a $1.75 billion debt offering. The issuer agreed to sell $900 million of 5.400% Senior Notes due 2031 at 99.966% of par and $850 million of 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036 at 98.375% of par, with semi-annual interest payments beginning April 15, 2027. Net proceeds are estimated at approximately $1.72 billion after underwriting discounts and fees. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no equity, merger, or restructuring event is involved.
